verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that gives AI agents tools for the Stripe API and its knowledge base, with a human approval gate on sensitive write actions. A runtime probe confirms the hosted endpoint at mcp.stripe.com is live and returns the OAuth challenge described in the docs. Missing for 10: no documented tool list showing agentic-commerce-specific capabilities (ACS checkout, SPTs) through the MCP server, and no independent hands-on report of a completed agent connection.
